title: Robustness Gym: Unifying the NLP Evaluation Landscape
benchmark_measurement: Performance degradation on text containing religious identity terms, as part of a broader analysis on identity-sensitive words.
findings: In a case study with a commercial sentiment model, the system's performance was evaluated on subpopulations containing identity-sensitive words (including religious terms). No performance degradation was found on the nine identity-sensitive words tested.
